message.content: Based on the conversations shared, both Li Hua and Yuriko express an interest in playing a mix of genres, particularly enjoying classic rock and acoustic songs. Li Hua mentions that Yuriko loves playing bass and enjoys classic rock, which she considers to have "great melodies." Additionally, Yuriko suggests collaborating on a medley featuring classic rock songs, indicating a preference for this genre. Furthermore, during a previous jam session, Li Hua proposes the medley "Hotel California" and "Sweet Home Alabama," both of which fall under classic rock. This demonstrates their affinity for classic rock music. While they also mention other genres, their preference seems to lean towards classic rock and acoustic songs.
